["meta-llama/llama-3.3-70b-instruct", "In addition, on both sides of the toilet seat there shall be a free space of at least 800 millimetres.", "Does this provision concern a building?"]

["meta-llama/llama-3.3-70b-instruct", "All walls, ducts and boxings to every WC/cloakroom, bath and shower room are strong enough to support grab rails, seats and other adaptations that could impose a load of 1.5kN/m2.", "Does this provision concern a building?"]
["meta-llama/llama-3.3-70b-instruct", "The resilient layer should be timber sheathing at least 9mm thick, expanded metal or a similar resilient material.", "Does this provision concern a building?"]

["meta-llama/llama-3.3-70b-instruct", "NOTE: For grid-supplied electricity, a CO2 emission factor of 0.136kgCO2/kWh and primary energy factor of 1.501kWhPE/kWh should be used.", "Does this provision concern a building?"]

["meta-llama/llama-3.3-70b-instruct", "An existing district heat network that is being connected to a new dwelling should not have a CO2 emission factor for delivered heat to the dwelling which is greater than 0.350kgCO2/kWh.", "Does this provision concern a building?"]

["meta-llama/llama-3.3-70b-instruct", "If the building has a floor area greater than 150m2, heating should be split into different heating zones and each zone should have separate controls for timing and temperature demand.", "Does this provision concern a building?"]
["meta-llama/llama-3.3-70b-instruct", "Extract air of categories 2, 3 and 4 shall not be used as recirculation air.", "Does this provision concern a building?"]

["meta-llama/llama-3.3-70b-instruct", "Under-floor heating systems intended for intermittent or cyclical operation and/or installed over unheated rooms should be separated from the structural floor by a layer of insulation with a thermal resistance of at least 1.25(m2K)/W.", "Does this provision concern a building?"]
["meta-llama/llama-3.3-70b-instruct", "Storage premises with a fire load exceeding 1,200 MJ/m2 are not permitted within the building.", "Does this provision concern a building?"]

["meta-llama/llama-3.3-70b-instruct", "The structure of the control appliance of the plumbing fixture shall be such that its surface temperature does not arise above 40 degrees Celsius.", "Does this provision concern a building?"]
